mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id, employee_id, shift_type, shift_start_time, shift_end_time, start_date, end_date, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete FROM hr_employee_shift WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 1 AND is_delete = 0 AND start_date <= #{date} AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= #{date}) ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1
